description: The supplied image is not a scientific figure panel. It is the standard CrossRef "Check for updates" publisher badge: a single square graphic on a light grey-to-white background containing a circular ring built from two thick arc segments — blue (upper and right side) and yellow (lower and left side) — which encloses a red ribbon/bookmark glyph. Below the ring the words "Check for updates" are printed on two lines in dark grey sans-serif type. There are no axes, no units, no scale bar, no legend, no scale or magnification marker, no curves, no spectra, no micrograph and no sample label anywhere in the image. No numeric value is printed. It therefore carries no information about the Fe–30Mn–11Al–1.2C (wt%) low-density steel, its cold-rolling microstructure, texture evolution or mechanical properties, and it cannot serve as evidence for any materials-science claim. Nothing in the pixels confirms or contradicts the paper's subject matter; the group is a journal front-matter artefact rather than content-bearing data.
